AqGWwoWXzijFs427.description: Megadamage (MDMG) is like a character’s Damage and Wounds rolled into one. Whenever your ship takes MDMG, add it to any previous MDMG incurred, mark the new total on the tracker, and apply the listed effect. If your ship ever has 9 or more total MDMG, it is destroyed.
